About

Our Journey: Celebrating 20+ Years of Trust & Legacy

Chaudhary Vastralay is proud to be one of the most premium and celebrated clothing destinations in Khutauna. Our legacy spans over 20 years, built on the sheer hard work and dedication of our proprietor, Chaudhary Ji. Long before establishing our first counter, Chaudhary Ji began this journey by personally traveling and delivering quality fabrics to people on bicycles and rickshaws, earning the deep-rooted love and trust of the local community.

Our Milestones

  1. The Humble Beginnings

    Started by serving customers door-to-door, laying the foundation of trust.

  2. 2007First Counter

    Opened our first official outlet at Station Chowk, Khutauna Market.

  3. 2014Expansion

    Moved to a larger space next to the Petrol Pump in Khutauna Market to accommodate our growing family of customers.

  4. 2023 - PresentOur Permanent Destination

    Shifted to our permanent modern showroom at Baril Chowk (Next to MRF Tyre Agency, East of Gumti).

Why Shop With Us?

We specialize in complete wedding and festive wear collections for the entire family. From exclusive designer Sarees and heavy bridal Lehengas to premium Sherwanis, Suits, Men's wear, and beautiful Kids' wear— we bring the finest fashion to Khutauna at the most honest prices.
